text:
Maria (eng-sre): Quick follow-up from the Ember on-prem isolation postmortem — capturing owners, timelines, and next steps so nothing falls through the cracks. I'll shepherd triage until Wed and then hand off to infra rotation.

Maria (eng-sre): Action summary (short):
- Josh: fix VPC peering route propagation + test (owner) — target: Fri EOD
- Anita: rollback playbook + canary deploy test harness (owner) — target: Tue noon
- Sam: scheduled peer-health automation + alerting (owner) — target: next sprint start
- Lisa: customer comms + access for on-prem runbook testing — target: Tue afternoon
- Platform: attach postmortem labels and surface recurring pattern to incidentstanford board

Josh (eng-platform): I'll take the peering config. Initial hypothesis: route table propagation race when onprem edge re-advertises after flap. Need the raw logs from the flap window.

Maria (eng-sre): Pasted the snip from the edge logs we collected during the outage:
```
[2024-05-02T14:03:21Z] BGP: withdraw prefix 10.12.0.0/24 -> peer-edge-1
[2024-05-02T14:03:22Z] Routes: peering-route-table updated (stale entry detected)
[2024-05-02T14:03:24Z] Service: connection resets, KV cache miss spike
```

Anita (eng-runtime): For rollback/playbook: I'll produce a two-step rollback (model -> small-quant variant -> thundering herd guard). I need access to run the canary against Ember test org. @Lisa can you grant temporary run access to my service account?

Lisa (prodops): Granted. Gave Anita the ember-canary-run token, expires in 72h. :white_check_mark:

Sam (infra): I'll author the peer-health probe and make it run every 2m with a 3-failure alarm. Also adding a check for route-staleness and BGP-flap correlation. Question: do we want an automatic rollback when peer-health fails 3 times in <10m, or just a pager?

Maria (eng-sre): Start with pager + silent throttled rollback candidate. We don't want noisy rollbacks during noisy neighbors — so alert -> run bounded failover plan -> if subsequent anomalies persist for 15m, trigger auto fallback to regional fallback pool. Documented in the runbook.

Josh (eng-platform): Will open PR for the peering config and link test matrix. Plan: patch route-propagation order + introduce a 10s reconcile backoff to avoid transient overwrites.

Anita (eng-runtime): I'll add canary smoke tests validating connectivity and KV-cache priming before traffic cutover. Will also add a small load-step in the harness to catch throttle regressions.

Maria (eng-sre): Two recurring patterns we noticed in the postmortem that we should track as separate action items: 1) isolation after edge BGP flaps during peak write windows, 2) stale route table reconciliation races when on-prem controllers re-advertise prefixes. Adding to "recurring-isolation-patterns" board.

Lisa (prodops): I filed a customer-facing status note template and scheduled a sync with Ember ops for Tue 1500 PST to review runbook and access assumptions.

ops-bot: Created issue #4682: "ember-onprem-vpc-peering-propagation-fix" and linked to postmortem doc. Assignee: Josh. Due: 2024-05-10.

Josh (eng-platform): Quick ask — does the team want a canary in a mirrored private tenant first, or run against Ember staging? I prefer mirrored private tenant to avoid test-data bleed.

Anita (eng-runtime): Mirrored private tenant preferred. I'll coordinate with Lisa to allocate ephemeral tenant for 48h.

Maria (eng-sre): OK. Ownership handoff plan:
- This thread owner (Maria) will track progress daily until Fri.
- Josh owns the GH issue and PRs.
- Anita owns rollback/playbook and harness.
- Sam owns automation and alerting.
- Lisa owns customer comms and access.

Maria (eng-sre): Please add short status updates in thread (one-liners) when you make progress so I can update the central tracker. Example: "Josh: PR opened -> link // Anita: canary infra provisioned"

Sam (infra): Noted — I'll add the probe and push a spike test next 24h.

Josh (eng-platform): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/742 (WIP). Adding reviewers @Anita @Maria.

Anita (eng-runtime): Canary infra provisioned on mirrored tenant. Running smoke now. 3/3 smoke tests green.

Maria (eng-sre): Thanks — marking this thread as active follow-up. I'll update the postmortem checklist and mark owners in the tracker. If we hit blockers, escalate in #eng-runtime and ping oncall. :raised_hands:

Lisa (prodops): Customer sync confirmed for Tue 1500 PST.

ops-bot: Linked GH #742 to #4682 and added label "postmortem-action".

Maria (eng-sre): Closing daily update: Josh -> PR moved to review; Anita -> test harness green; Sam -> probe in staging; Lisa -> comms scheduled. Next check-in Wednesday 11:00 PST.
